Art direction: one unified high-end hand-painted 2D cinematic storybook world, warm cream sandstone, weathered honey brass, deep blue glass and restrained brick-red accents, fine visible painterly brushwork, realistic coherent scale and perspective, natural cinematic light and contact shadows. The magnet mascots must be PAINTED INTO THIS SAME WORLD, not pasted stickers: soften all edges and contours like the architecture, NO thick black cartoon outline, no vector art, no glossy plastic/toy render, no white cutout border, no oversaturated primary colors, no exaggerated huge eyes. Their bodies are gently worn matte enamel metal, muted warm vermilion and muted deep cobalt reflecting the scene's warm light, subtle paint-grain, soft shadows, natural small facial features. Identity shape only from original mascot references: exactly ONE Mili, red U-shaped body with silver tips, two eyes and mouth on body, two slim charcoal arms and two legs, two warm ivory gloves and two red/ivory shoes; exactly ONE Dangi, U-shaped body with silver tips, viewer-left muted red/viewer-right muted blue, two eyes/mouth on body, two slim charcoal arms/two legs, exactly TWO gloves, red/ivory left shoe and blue/ivory right shoe, small tan clipboard. NO human heads or clothing. The U magnet shape remains legible but character size and chroma must NOT overpower the environment. Both characters share identical painted edge softness, light direction, color grading, detail level and ground-plane shadows with the room. No additional characters unless explicitly requested. Text-free, no logos/watermarks/UI/panels/collage. No magic beams or electricity from magnets, no levitating nonmagnetic objects. Landscape full-bleed 16:9, ideally 1920x1080.
INTRO 01: 'We enter the stopped postal district'. Architecture reference is a city STYLE reference ONLY, never copy its overview composition. The original mascot sheets are SHAPE IDENTITY ONLY, completely REPAINT their rendering to harmonize with the architectural painting, remove bold comic outlines. CAMERA: low street-level 28mm wide diagonal composition, from just inside a shadowed cream-stone arch, looking along a winding postal lane into sunlight, strong immersive foreground framing. Close RIGHT foreground a weathered cream and deep red mailbox is partly cropped, its little hinged door open and metal latch visible, envelopes resting inside. LEFT midground is a beautiful red-awning post office doorway with envelope-shaped glazing, open door showing parcel cubbies. Overhead brass delivery pipes, rails running at street level toward a blue-domed lab in distance. A small parcel trolley is stopped halfway along its rail. Mili and Dangi are inhabitants in this environment, each only about 23% of frame height, placed in the MIDDLE DISTANCE rather than huge in foreground: Mili beside the open post-office entrance turns slightly back toward the viewer and makes one gentle beckoning gesture toward the street to invite us into the investigation; Dangi beside the mailbox, at matching depth, studies the faulty latch, holding clipboard with ONE glove and touching latch with the OTHER, exactly two arms and two hands total, no hand near mouth. Warm inquisitive expressions. Clear visual reason to help the city: open mailbox and stalled parcel delivery, otherwise intact welcoming city. Characters never pose symmetrically to camera. Sunlight glances along cobblestones, soft dusty gold and cool blue shadows, immersive magical-place feeling but physically grounded science. No central plaza/core, no aerial perspective, no distant panoramic postcard.

INTRO FRAME 02: 'Inside the materials-and-magnet research laboratory: a clue to discover'. Input image 1 defines the NEW integrated painterly character treatment and city art direction: preserve their smaller softer eye shapes, matte worn enamel, subtle edge treatment, warm contact light, no bold cartoon outlines. Input image 2 is architectural reference for THIS INTERIOR, not a composition to copy. This frame must look completely different from intro 01: now INSIDE the materials research stage, under arched cream windows, brass pipes and cabinets of sample jars, bright cool daylight from left mixed with warm wood reflections. CAMERA: intimate 45-degree high-angle three-quarter OVER-THE-SHOULDER view from just behind Mili's left shoulder at the corner of a large honey-wood science workbench, 40mm perspective; foreground workbench and three tactile material samples fill lower 55% of image. Mili's red U headless body is partly visible in the lower LEFT side looking INTO the scene, not facing camera, its two gloves naturally on tabletop, one next to a small ordinary unlabelled muted-red/blue bar magnet. Dangi on the far RIGHT side of the workbench leans in, holds clipboard tucked in ONE hand, and holds a magnifying glass in the OTHER to inspect a tiny cluster of steel paperclips TOUCHING one end of the ordinary magnet. Exactly two arms/hands each; no additional hand by face. Nearby a wooden cube and aluminum disk remain resting separately on the table, NOT attracted or floating. Characters should feel about the same physical size as in image 1, 25% of frame height at most, environment and objects are protagonists. In the rear of the room, an open arched passage reveals a short balcony route leading toward the next polarity-repair building with a red-blue circular apparatus on a fixed vertical support, a small visual invitation to continue exploring. No aerial city, no central plaza, no mailbox, no rail cart in this interior, no symmetric front-facing character pose. Mood: tactile scientific curiosity, discovery about to happen, cinematic focus falls on magnet and paperclips, faces softly readable, warm hopeful adventure. Match city materials and unified fine-painted texture; this must feel like walking from the postal street into the next stage, not a different art universe. Do not add text, labels, numbers or modern screens.

INTRO FRAME 03: 'The invention workshop is waiting for YOUR idea'. Inputs 1 and 2 define unified character rendering and city art direction; preserve the softer integrated faces, matte warm-painted metal and painterly shadows. Input 3 defines workshop materials only. STRONGLY DIFFERENT COMPOSITION from the previous close laboratory table: this is a WIDE DEEP INTERIOR viewed from the doorway at a slight LOW ANGLE, 26mm perspective, with foreground dark door jamb on LEFT and a broad shaft of late-morning sunlight across the visible stone FLOOR leading to a midground invention bench. A workshop that a player can walk into: tall cream stone walls, one oversized brass gear set into back wall, navy wooden drawers, hanging simple hand tools, brass lamps, a large arched balcony window on RIGHT showing a GLASS AQUARIUM DOME and elevated narrow delivery track outside, teasing the remote-control district we passed. Large readable zones of floor and room, not a flat wall behind a close-up tabletop. Mili is at the RIGHT foreground beside the open door, about 30% frame height, naturally seen three-quarter side, holding the door open with ONE glove and making an open welcoming palm toward the room with the OTHER, gentle encouraging smile toward viewer. Dangi is farther LEFT at the midground bench, about 20% frame height, holding tan clipboard in one hand and indicating the unfinished project with the other. Exactly two hands/arms each. On the middle-distance bench are clearly UNASSEMBLED inventor parts: a small rectangular honey-wood cart base, four loose dark wheels, one small square silver steel front plate, an ordinary muted-red/blue bar magnet, a tiny cream parcel tied with string, and a simple faint pencil outline drawing on tan paper, NO writing. A short straight two-rail brass test track sits beside these parts and ends at a small round docking stop. All objects rest on the bench, no self-moving/levitation/magical energy. This little cart project is a visual EXAMPLE of the kind of invention awaiting the learner, not yet completed. Emotional purpose: after seeing problems and discovering magnetic clues, the viewer feels welcomed to take the empty place at the workbench and make something useful. Broad warm hopeful light, memorable adventurous threshold shot. Keep characters integrated, not bright sticker cutouts. No symmetrical front-facing lineup, no central city panorama, no repeated lab table closeup, no text or labels.

The ordinary muted red/blue bar magnet is held just AHEAD of the cart's steel front plate by one glove of Mili entering from RIGHT, a SMALL VISIBLE AIR GAP between magnet and steel; no direct push, no magic beam, no levitation. Inputs 1 and 2 define the same integrated painterly magnet inhabitants and consistent city materials; input 3 is architecture reference ONLY, not composition. Exactly TWO hands/arms and two feet each, painted enamel bodies, no bold outline. Reference images 1 and 2 define the exact integrated small warm-painted magnet characters and restored city architectural world. CAMERA: ground-level low-angle 35mm HERO WIDE SHOT from the last steps leading UP to a small round cream-stone celebration dais; framing is slightly diagonal and intimate, like arriving at a ceremony held for the viewer. Mili looks warmly toward the viewer, open smile, one ivory glove presents the medallion, other glove raised in a small congratulatory greeting. Dangi holds the SAME tan clipboard in ONE glove and presents the blank parchment/medal with the OTHER, proud reassuring smile, exactly two arms and hands each. Neither mascot touches or holds extra duplicate items. Behind the dais, FIVE long narrow navy/brick-red celebration pennants strung across the cream arches each have ONE SIMPLE GOLD PICTOGRAM representing a visited district: envelope, material sample cube, ring magnet, water drop, cogwheel. Cream city facades, blue glass domes, restored lights and tiny festive ribbons surround the plaza. The delivery trolley can be small and parked naturally at far RIGHT by an arch, callback to restored life.
